title: Research Approval Package
description: The human-facing payload assembled by the 'Create Research Approval' workflow and served by the development approval endpoint (GET /internal/dev/research-approvals/:id). Combines the current research package (get_current_research_package), QC result, and research-stage cost so a reviewer can approve/reject/request-revision without querying the database directly. See docs/architecture/research-pipeline.md#human-research-approval.

research_package.description: The full get_current_research_package() payload — synthesis, source_summary, and grouped claims (verified_fact, likely_fact, opinion, inference, unsupported, conflicting, time_sensitive).
